findings.title: Retro instructions route tasks into file_scope rejection
findings.desc: New prompt steps 3–4 make every task agent write `docs/thoughts/retro-r${ROUND}-${TASK_ID}.md`, but no file_scope (gate 1c) change appears in the diff — the ADR added in this same commit states that gate permits only `docs/working/`. If it wasn't widened elsewhere, tasks that obey the new instructions produce out-of-scope diffs and are rejected by the loop's own validation.

findings.title: Prompt and ADR reference a code-review merge gate this diff doesn't add
findings.desc: The prompt tells agents "the loop ... re-runs code-review as a merge gate and rejects red findings," and the ADR/log present Tier A (scope widening) and Tier B (gate 1h, `CODE_REVIEW_RED` sentinel, `si-functions.sh` verdict helpers with unit tests) as part of this change — none of that code is in the diff. Agents will calibrate their pre-ship work on a gate that doesn't exist, and the decision log overstates what shipped.

findings.title: Harvest commits unvalidated LLM output and swallows all failures
findings.desc: `claude -p` is fed agent-written retros and whatever it writes to `failure-patterns.md` is committed to main with no schema/numbering verification (the "do not modify existing entries" constraint exists only in the prompt), while `2>/dev/null || true` on both the claude call and the git commit makes malformation or failure invisible.

findings.title: /away-mode agents told to run a skill the ADR itself calls interactive
findings.desc: Step 2 has autonomous agents run `skills/code-review`, which the ADR describes as an orchestrator whose fact-check gate "pauses for input" — the very reason Tier B needed a sentinel contract. No headless accommodation is specified for the agent-side run, so tasks risk stalling or quietly skipping that gate.

findings.title: Unguarded grep pipeline can abort the round under pipefail
findings.desc: The `grep|sed|sort|tail` computing NEXT_FP is the only fallible command in the block without a guard; if `failure-patterns.md` contains no `FP-` entries, grep exits 1 and, under `set -e`/`pipefail` (which the surrounding `|| echo ""` / `|| true` guards imply), the script dies after merges, skipping the hypothesis-log append that follows.

findings.title: Prompt mandates retro writes to docs/thoughts/, but the Tier A file_scope widening and Tier B code-review gate described in decision 020 are absent from this diff
findings.desc: The record's own Context states file_scope currently allows only docs/working/, so the newly required retro-r${ROUND}-${TASK_ID}.md write will trip the scope gate and get every task rejected (and the harvest below will find no retros). The record and log.md entry 20 also claim gate 1h, parse_code_review_red/code_review_gate_verdict in si-functions.sh, and unit tests — none of which appear anywhere in this commit — and the prompt's claim to agents that "the loop re-runs code-review as a merge gate" is unsupported by the diff.

findings.title: Fix-task detection checks only the branch tip commit subject
findings.desc: A fix task whose tip commit is a separate retro/docs commit, or whose summary commit omits the fix: prefix (the prompt says conventional prefixes are only "preferred"), is silently skipped, so its failure pattern is never harvested; scanning all commits in the branch range or carrying the task type through would be more robust.
